2607.04690.title: PAST-TIDE: Prototype-Anchored Statement Tuning with Topic-Invariant Normalization for Stance Detection
2607.04690.paper_summary: We introduce PAST-TIDE, our stance detection system addressing both subtasks of the StanceNakba Shared Task at NakbaNLP@LREC-COLING 2026. The main idea is statement tuning. We redefine stance as cloze-style masked language modeling (MLM), letting a verbalizer map label words to stance categories through the pre-trained MLM head rather than appending a randomly initialized classification head. We complement this with prototypical contrastive learning, which uses learnable class prototypes for batch-size independent contrastive training, and topic-conditional layer normalization for cross-topic Arabic stance detection. PAST-TIDE achieves macro-F1 scores of 0.75 for Subtask A and 0.74 for Subtask B on the official leaderboard, indicating that minimal architectural additions to a pre-trained model can remain competitive in low-resource settings.
2607.04690.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹 PAST-TIDE，這是一個針對 NakbaNLP@LREC-COLING 2026 的 StanceNakba 共享任務的立場檢測系統，旨在解決兩個子任務。主要思想是聲明調整。我們將立場重新定義為填空式的掩碼語言模型 (MLM)，讓一個語言化器通過預訓練的 MLM 頭將標籤詞映射到立場類別，而不是附加一個隨機初始化的分類頭。我們用原型對比學習來補充這一點，該方法使用可學習的類原型進行批次大小獨立的對比訓練，並使用主題條件層正規化來進行跨主題的阿拉伯立場檢測。在官方排行榜上，PAST-TIDE 在子任務 A 上達到了 0.75 的宏 F1 分數，在子任務 B 上達到了 0.74，這表明對預訓練模型進行最小的架構增強仍然可以在低資源環境中保持競爭力。
